 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER
This i s second application under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973, filed by the applicant for grant of bail.
T h e applicant has been arrested relating to FIR/ Crime No.32/2022, registered at Police Station Saikheda, District Betul (M.P) for the offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(N), 506 of IPC.
The applicant is in custody since 22.12.2022.
Earlier bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 2.02.2023 passed in M.Cr.C No. 5240 of 2023.
As per prosecution case, the allegation against the present applicant is that he committed repeated rape with the prosecutrix on the pretext of false promise to marry her.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the alleged offence.
Charge-sheet has been filed.
The applicant has no criminal antecedents.
Learned counsel for applicant further submits that prosecutrix is a major lady.
Statement of the prosecutrix has been recorded before the trial court.
Conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
Under such circumstances, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the non-applicant/State opposed the prayer and prays for its rejection.
However fairly submit that applicant has no criminal antecedent.
Learned counsel for the complainant/victim submitted that applicant is going to marry the prosecutrix in near future.

Looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, on a perusal of the material available on record;
without commenting on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.
It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
Pending I.A., if any, also stands disposed off.
Certified Copy, as per rules.
The M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed off.

(RAJENDRA KUMAR (VERMA)) JUDGE tarun Manoj vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115818044/
